children: StoneX maintained their Buy rating on Third Coast Bancshares's stock with a price target of $54.00.
The price target implies an upside of 35.0% from the Oct 22 close of $40.
Key takeaways from the analyst note
Strong Loan Growth and Revenue Potential

: Third Coast Bancshares demonstrated a robust loan growth of 11% on a last quarter annualized (LQA) basis, indicating healthy demand for their commercial banking services. This growth, coupled with a solid revenue stream from interest on loans and customer service fees, positions the bank favorably for continued profitability.
Resilience in Earnings and NIM Recovery

: Despite a slight contraction in net interest margin (NIM) to 3.70%, expectations for a rebound to 3.90% following a pending deal suggest that Third Coast Bancshares is on track for improved financial performance. Their ability to exceed earnings expectations in a challenging environment reinforces confidence in their future growth trajectory.
